changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-bailian-image-creator skill.

- Supports AI image generation, editing, and understanding using Alibaba Cloud DashScope API.
- Strictly enforces all tasks via verified scripts; no custom code or third-party services allowed.
- Automatically manages API keys and security with zero manual key handling required.
- Provides detailed task-to-script and model selection mapping for different user requests.
- Implements robust validation for API responses, output files, and security before reporting success.
summary: Generates, edits, and analyzes images using Alibaba Cloud DashScope API with supported qwen and wan2.7 models via predefined scripts.
